announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Steadily on course following repayment of all promissory notes due in 2026
announcements.insight: Following July restructuring agreements, all 2026 promissory notes have been repaid. This resolves financial liabilities and reduces refinancing risk for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: GreenBiz Park Erding fully let
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies that a specific asset has been fully leased, which generally indicates stable rental income generation for the shareholder base. It reflects operational progress in property management without disclosing financial magnitude or strategic shifts.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Successful renewal of lease with existing tenant at the Ludwigshafen Technology Park
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the renewal of a lease with an existing tenant, which generally indicates operational continuity and stable rental income for property investors. It represents routine asset management activity rather than a transformative event or significant financial change.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: VIB Vermögen AG: Lock-Up Agreements with noteholders and promissory noteholders of BRANICKS Group AG have become fully effective
announcements.insight: Following the July restructuring agreements, lock-up provisions for BRANICKS Group AG noteholders are now effective, confirming progress in the debt resolution process.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: VIB Vermögen AG: Agreements on the restructuring of financial liabilities of BRANICKS Group AG signed, incl. commitment for a € 60 mn financing for VIB Vermögen AG
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG secures €60mn financing to support BRANICKS Group restructuring. This follows recent joint venture and leasing activity, indicating strategic capital deployment.
